description: Find places to stay, eat and visit in a named destination by text, category, area or tags. Every query word matches, in any order; each business appears once (also_listed_as) with a snippet and map_url, so call it again with listing_id for the full text. An unknown filter value's reason lists the valid ones.

area.description: Area name or slug; destination_overview lists them.

category.description: Category name or slug; destination_overview lists them.

cursor.description: Number of items to skip; pass `next_cursor` from the previous page.

destination.description: Destination name or slug, e.g. 'Los Cabos'; list_cities names them.

language.description: Language code (e.g. 'en', 'es'); defaults to the destination's.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

listing_id.description: One listing's id from a previous result: returns its full detail in item, ignoring the other filters; read a live linked_venue_slug with the venue_* tools and book via its booking link.

near_listing_id.description: A listing id; returns listings within radius_km, nearest first, each with distance_km.

query.description: Words matched in any order against listing names, descriptions, tags and categories.

radius_km.description: Search radius in km around near_listing_id; a larger value is reduced to the server maximum.

tags.description: Tag slugs; only listings carrying ALL are returned.

name: destination_listings

outputSchema.description: The Yenta response envelope: a status, the answer in `item` or `items`, and the approved content revision it was read from.

title: Search a destination's listings by name
